verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Bolt's own building agents (Standard/Max), its model routing, and AI image generation used while building. Nothing shows a built-in way to add runtime LLM calls or agents to the generated app without the user supplying provider keys. Supabase edge functions and third-party API calls are developer building blocks, not a managed AI capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI features like LLM calls and agents to my generated app without managing provider keys myself
